scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,classic,modern -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @lab/mock-api dev" "pnpm --filter classic dev" "pnpm --filter modern dev"
scripts.dev:classic: concurrently -n api,classic -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter @lab/mock-api dev" "pnpm --filter classic dev"
scripts.dev:modern: concurrently -n api,modern -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @lab/mock-api dev" "pnpm --filter modern dev"
scripts.build: node scripts/with-mock.mjs sh -c "pnpm --filter classic build && pnpm --filter modern build"
scripts.start:prod: concurrently -n api,classic,modern -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @lab/mock-api start" "pnpm --filter classic start" "pnpm --filter modern start"
scripts.e2e: pnpm build && pnpm --filter classic e2e && pnpm --filter modern e2e
